title.en: Turn masking on and exclude the checkout

detail.en: Two changes: mask all input by default, and stop the tool loading on the checkout path entirely. The second is the one that matters.

forwardable.en: Or forward it to your developer — it reads the same either way.

body.en:
On {{domain}}, {{tool}} ({{tool_host}}) is active on {{path}} with input masking off. It records what customers type into {{fields}} before they submit anything.

Two changes, and the second matters more than the first:
1. Turn input masking on globally.
2. Prevent the {{tool}} script from loading at all on any path under {{path}}.

When you are done: show me the change and how to verify the script is entirely absent on {{path}}.
